The Edel
「《Lowen》, who endured his hatred of women, had the Chaos
　Leo for an experiment to steal Gunleon's Sphere...」

The Edel
「《Schlan》's Chaos Anguis was for an experiment using
　Ophiuchus's dimensional Power, second only to the twelve
　zodiac constellations, nya~.」

AG
「We must seize the future for 《Lowen》 and 《Schlan》 too, who
　lost themselves in the chaos of the multiverse.」
